units.en: Manage advisors and theorists, choose your army, navy, and air spirits, and unlock doctrines.
The ⟦0⟧ tab gives an overall summary of the status of the armed forces and allows management of the military leadership and way of warfare. It was added in ⟦1⟧ (Barbarossa).
In this tab, players can see their allocated ⟦0⟧, as well as daily army, navy, and air experience gain. Hovering over any of these will display a tooltip with more details.
You may review and edit your military advisors from this tab, just as you would from your ⟦0⟧.
Additionally, this area displays the modifiers that affect the whole of the army, navy, and air force, such as army reinforce rate, max planning, sortie efficiency, air support efficiency, etc.

However, the primary purpose of this tab is to review and unlock ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ doctrines. Players with ⟦3⟧ can also boost their armies, navies, and air wings with brand new 'spirits'. The army and navy commands may have up to three spirits each, while the air force command may have up to two. There are many options to choose from, and many different combinations are possible. There are also spirits which are only accessible depending on the doctrines that have been selected, or even the nation's ideology. Any and all of these choices can be made in exchange for a varying amount of army, navy, or air experience. The bonuses and de-buffs from doctrines and spirits take effect immediately.
Players who have access to divisional commanders (with ⟦0⟧) can also access a window that allows them to review and promote those officers.

Generals and Admirals may become Military advisors when they reach level 4. At Level 4, he will be a specialist, at Level 6 he will become an expert, and at Level 8 he will become a genius. His acquired traits will dictate his contributions to the military high command.

Doctrines are research paths that allow a country to specialize its army, navy, and air forces. Each doctrine has a base cost of 100 of its respective experience, which can be modified by spirits, advisors, and special bonuses from focuses, events, or decisions.
Main article: Combat tactics § Preferred Tactics
The preferred tactic of a country can be set at the officer corps for 20⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. This increases the probability that ⟦2⟧ select that ⟦3⟧ when they are commanding a ⟦4⟧.
Army spirits provide bonuses to ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and the army generally.
These spirits provide bonuses to land commanders, such as increasing XP gain for certain traits, an improved chance of gaining stats, or reduced hiring cost.
